name: BubbleTent Australia
niche_feature: Five 'Bubbletents' (Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Ophiuchus, Pisces) on one off-grid property above Capertee Valley; VisitNSW describes a clear bubble with a rotating bed. Official site does not itself say transparent.

reason: Bubble tents confirmed by tourism board and official site, though the property is in Capertee Valley, not Hunter Valley.
page_issues: Wrong location: property is in Capertee Valley near Lithgow/Mudgee (Capertee NSW 2846), not the Hunter Valley
'150-plus cellar doors on the doorstep' is wrong for this location; official site says halfway between Mudgee and Lithgow
Official site says 2.5 hours from Sydney, not two
Official site lists outdoor shower and wood-fired bath as standard in every tent, not 'selected tents'; complimentary wine and Bluetooth speaker not found
Adults-only and two-night minimum not mentioned

name: Bulles d'Olive
niche_feature: Two transparent bubbles (Olea, Provence) plus a wooden cabin (Zome Céleste) at a guesthouse in Nyons; only the two bubbles are the niche.

reason: Official site confirms transparent bubbles; one of three units is a cabin.

niche_feature: Glass igloos (small, large, Kelo-Glass igloos with log-chalet bedrooms) in East and West villages, alongside ordinary log cabins and chalets, suites, and snow igloos. Glass igloos run late August to April.

reason: Glass igloos confirmed on official site; resort also has many non-glass cabins and chalets.
page_issues: Founder given as Yrjö Rissanen; official site names resort owner Mr. Eiramo
'More than 65 igloos' and 'world's largest glass igloo village' not found on official pages

'35 km inside the Arctic Circle' not supported by official pages (Saariselkä is about 68.4N)
Page presents resort as only glass igloos; it also sells log cabins and chalets
bookingUrl points to Booking.com
